title: Remove Boxes
summary: You are provided with multiple boxes of various colors, each color represented by a unique positive number.
statement: You are provided with multiple boxes of various colors, each color represented by a unique positive number. You can perform multiple rounds of removal where you select a continuous segment of boxes with the same color, remove them, and earn points equal to the square of the number of boxes removed. The goal is to maximize the total points earned by removing all boxes.
constraints: Removing a contiguous same-color run of length k earns k squared; maximize the total.
hints: The future value of an interval depends on how many matching boxes are already attached to its right edge.
Memoize left, right, and carried count; either remove the right run now or merge it with an earlier equal color.
Compress equal suffix boxes, score removal, and try every matching split point.
Every optimal first action for the rightmost color is either immediate removal or one specific intervening segment removed to enable a merge.
editorial: Every optimal first action for the rightmost color is either immediate removal or one specific intervening segment removed to enable a merge.

tests.explanation: Delaying matching colors until intervening boxes disappear produces twenty-three points.
Removing all three equal boxes together earns nine.
